page_title: Relationship between camera angle and distance

The relationship between the millimeter rating of a surveillance camera and the angle is as follows:

The smaller the millimeter rating of the camera lens, the larger the angle of the monitoring image (larger range), but the distance at which the image is clearest is shorter (close-up); conversely, the larger the millimeter rating of the camera lens, the smaller the angle of the monitoring image (smaller range), but the distance at which the image is clearest is farther (long shot).

Focal length: The focal length of a surveillance camera refers to the distance between the lens and the photosensitive element. The magnification of the lens is approximately equal to the ratio of the focal length to the object distance. That is, as the focal length of the surveillance camera increases, the magnification increases, which can push the close-up farther away and make the details of distant scenes clearer; the reverse also holds.
